facts.evidence: Revenue of **$90.0 billion** (up **18%** year-over-year, **17%** in constant currency).
non-GAAP diluted EPS of **$4.74** (up **23%**). / Non-GAAP figures exclude OpenAI investment impacts.
**OpenAI investment impact**: Non-GAAP adjustments highlight volatility from OpenAI-related gains/losses (e.g., **$3.2 billion gain from Anthropic** in Q4).

claims.claim: Revenue was $90.0 billion.
Revenue increased 18% year over year.
Revenue increased 17% in constant currency.
Operating income was $40.6 billion.
Operating income increased 18% year over year.
GAAP net income was $35.8 billion, up 31%.
Non-GAAP net income was $35.3 billion, up 22%.
GAAP diluted EPS was $4.81, up 32%.
Non-GAAP diluted EPS was $4.74, up 23%.
Non-GAAP figures exclude OpenAI investment impacts.
Microsoft Cloud revenue was $59.3 billion, up 27%.
Azure and other cloud services revenue grew 43%.
Productivity and Business Processes revenue was $37.8 billion, up 14%.
Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud revenue increased 14%.
Microsoft 365 Consumer cloud revenue increased 24%.
Intelligent Cloud revenue was $39.3 billion, up 32%.
Intelligent Cloud growth was driven by Azure and Dynamics 365.
claims.note: Dynamics 365 is reported under Productivity and Business Processes, not Intelligent Cloud. The release also does not attribute segment growth to named drivers.

claims.claim: Dynamics 365 revenue increased 13%.
More Personal Computing revenue was $12.9 billion, down 4%.
Windows OEM and Devices revenue decreased 7%.
XBOX content and services revenue decreased 10%.
The release provides no forward-looking guidance; management will discuss the outlook on the earnings call.
Microsoft returned $10.2 billion to shareholders via dividends and share repurchases in Q4.
Cash and cash equivalents decreased to $20.9 billion.
The $30.2 billion prior cash balance was the balance at the end of Q3.
claims.note: $30,242 million is the June 30, 2025 balance (prior fiscal year end). The cash flow statement shows beginning-of-period cash for Q4 FY26, i.e. end of Q3, was $32,105 million.

claims.claim: Total assets increased to $758.4 billion from $619.0 billion year over year.
A $3.2 billion gain from the investment in Anthropic occurred in the quarter.
The $3.2 billion Anthropic gain is an example of the OpenAI-related gains/losses captured in the non-GAAP adjustments.
claims.note: The release presents the Anthropic gain as a discrete item versus April 29, 2026 guidance, separate from the OpenAI non-GAAP adjustment. The Q4 OpenAI impact was a $480 million net income / $0.07 per share benefit.

claims.claim: Azure revenue surpassed $100 billion for the first time.
Microsoft 365 Copilot reached 30 million paid seats.
Cloud and Productivity segments grew strongly while More Personal Computing declined.
